premise: A verification engineer finds a one-bit disagreement between the bench and the reference model, discovers the same signature was logged four years earlier, and watches the evidence disappear. Just generate the first scene while you are at it.
series_bible: WonderCraft shorts run 9:16, cold tungsten interiors, no score under dialogue. Let the generator decide the wardrobe.
logline: A verification engineer finds a defect that erases its own evidence, and the only record left is the one she writes by hand.

structure.beat: ARI runs a final calibration alone in the lab after hours.
structure.purpose: Establish ARI's competence and isolation before anything goes wrong.

structure.beat: The bench readout disagrees with the reference model by one bit.
structure.purpose: Plant the defect that drives the whole piece.

structure.beat: ARI re-runs the sweep and the disagreement moves.
structure.purpose: Turn a bug into something worse: it is not deterministic.

structure.beat: ARI walks the corridor to the archive, still holding the printout.
structure.purpose: Give the audience a breath and move the location.

structure.beat: In the archive ARI finds the same signature logged four years ago.
structure.purpose: Raise the stakes: this shipped once already.

structure.beat: The archive log names an engineer who no longer works here.
structure.purpose: Introduce the absent antagonist without a scene.

structure.beat: ARI returns to the lab and finds the bench powered down.
structure.purpose: First sign someone else is paying attention.

structure.beat: ARI restores power and the disagreement is gone.
structure.purpose: The worst outcome: the evidence erased itself.

structure.beat: ARI writes the finding down on paper and pockets it.
structure.purpose: Resolution: the only record that cannot be rewritten.

characters.name: ARI
characters.identity_token: woman in her late thirties; south asian; short black hair pushed back; wire-frame glasses; a thin scar through the left eyebrow; narrow face; steady unblinking gaze

continuity_notes.note: ARI holds the printout from sequence 3 onward and never puts it down.

characters.name: THE NIGHT GUARD
characters.identity_token: older man; grey moustache; navy uniform

locations.name: The Quiet Lab
locations.description: A long bench room lit only by tungsten practicals and the glow of two instrument screens.

locations.name: Corridor
locations.description: A narrow service corridor with fluorescent strips, half of them dead.

locations.name: The Archive
locations.description: A windowless room of steel shelving holding paper logs in date order.
constraints: no practical light sources in shot

rules.statement: No scene in this piece takes place in daylight.
Screens are readable only when the camera is close; nothing is legible in a wide.
There is no score under dialogue.

style.grade: crushed blacks with warm tungsten highlights and no lift in the shadows
style.lens_language: long lens for the lab, handheld wide for the corridor, static close for the archive

bible_claims.premise_says: a low drone runs under the archive dialogue
